content.title: Clear the selected performance point when the time range changes
content.intent: Prove changing the time range clears any previously selected chart point after a lock has been established.
content.technique_notes: State/flow applied because the path verifies the cross-state reset from locked selection to cleared selection when another control changes chart context. Equivalence partitioning applied to use a representative time-range change rather than mint separate scenarios for each destination value because the expected outcome is the same cleared-selection state.
